Print a name N times using recursion with a counter.

Supplied answer
def print_name(count, n):
    if count > n:
        return
    print("Surya", end=" ")
    print_name(count + 1, n)
print_name(1, 5)
# passing the counter as a parameter is cleaner than using a global
Note: Prefer parameters over global variables in recursion - easier to test and reason about.
